name: Glide
tagline: No-code app builder for portals, dashboards, and mobile-style apps

pricing.notes: Official pricing URL checked; public 2026 references list Maker around $49/month annual-effective and roughly $60/month monthly.

verdictSummary: You can build one specific Glide app; you are not rebuilding the no-code app builder, data editor, permissions, and deployment platform in one sitting.
coreLoopDIY: Build the specific portal/dashboard needed using a normal web framework and database rather than rebuilding Glide itself.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because building one app is easier than becoming the developer for every future app change.

priorArt.name: NocoDB
priorArt.desc: Open-source no-code database; combine with a frontend for many Glide-like apps.

notes: Important distinction: vibecode the app, not the app builder.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Glide (No-code app builder for portals, dashboards, and mobile-style apps). Requirements:

- Core loop: Build the specific portal/dashboard needed using a normal web framework and database rather than rebuilding Glide itself.
- Needs: web framework.
- Needs: database.
- Needs: auth.
- Needs: hosting.
- Needs: mobile-responsive UI.
- Needs: optional app wrapper.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: visual builder; templates; data sync.
